geometry_edits.rationale: Introduce a clearer section logic to give the bar a more program-credible roof/profile while keeping the carved court ancestry intact.
A folded profile adds sectional articulation without turning the building into a different typology.
Keep the long dimension as the primary span so the linear street-building logic remains dominant.

graph_edits.rationale: Strengthen the upper mass as a more legible inhabited profile while preserving the dominant bar and public-ground relationship.
Slightly increase lift to reinforce the raised public base without making the mass look over-stacked.
Deepen the public void enough to read more clearly as usable open space along the access edge.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent single bar with a carved longitudinal court, and that court is legible in all views rather than being a view-specific artifact. The mass responds to the parcel as an oriented linear figure instead of simply filling the boundary, and the blue access edge is answered by a meaningful open seam/void along the ground condition. Hierarchy is clear: one dominant bar, one subtractive public void, minimal fragmentation. The silhouette is not especially strong as a section idea because the form remains largely box-like with limited roof/section expression, but it still supports the neighborhood-living brief through active threshold, public void, and calm upper massing. No obvious view collision or incoherent view-only gesture is present.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is tower-oriented and much more vertical than the candidate; do not import the tower typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Tall mass with a legible stepped/tapered upper profile and strong singular datum; useful as a precedent for maintaining one dominant body with controlled variation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office/tower precedent; candidate should stay low and street-responsive rather than become a tall isolated object.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Single-tower massing with a subtly deformed vertical profile and clear hierarchical crown; transferable as a principle of one primary body with articulated upper treatment.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Very small retail object; scale and program intensity are not comparable.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact low horizontal volume with an attached vertical accent and clear entry/canopy logic; good for active-ground-edge thinking.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual waterfront housing figure; use as a spatial principle, not as a form to copy.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Courtyard-like void with connected massing and terraced section; strong precedent for public-space subtraction and neighborhood openness.

warnings: Section/roof expression is relatively generic; a modest profiled or terraced section could better support the program without losing the calm bar datum.
The figure is coherent but still somewhat reliant on subtraction from a rectangular prism; avoid over-fragmentation in the next iteration.
